description:
At   Synechron , we harness the power of digital transformation to drive business success.  As a global consulting firm, we combine creativity with advanced technology to deliver innovative solutions across industries.  Recognized with multiple employer awards, we are committed to building talented teams and creating a dynamic work environment.   
 

 We are hiring a Java Engineer (DevOps-Oriented)   

 Hybrid working model - Novi Sad or Belgrade office   
 

 Role Description:   

 We are seeking a   Java Engineer with DevOps   expertise   to join our engineering team supporting large-scale enterprise and financial systems. This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys working across both application development and platform engineering, contributing to the design, development, deployment, and operation of modern cloud-native solutions.   

 You will work in a collaborative environment alongside software engineers, DevOps   specialists, and   business stakeholders to build scalable applications, automate delivery processes, and enhance operational excellence across the software development lifecycle.   
 

 Key Responsibilities:   

 Design, develop, test, and   maintain   Java-based applications and microservices   

 
 Build and integrate applications   leveraging   event-driven and pub/sub architectures   

 
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions   

 
 Develop and   maintain   CI/CD pipelines to enable efficient and reliable software delivery   

 
 Deploy, manage, and troubleshoot applications running in Kubernetes environments   

 
 Create and   maintain   Docker containers and containerized application deployments   

 
 Support cloud-native application development and deployment within AWS environments   

 
 Monitor application performance, system health, and operational metrics using observability and monitoring tools   

 
 Participate in incident investigation, root cause analysis, and production support activities   

 
 Contribute to infrastructure automation and continuous improvement initiatives   

 
 Ensure security, reliability, scalability, and maintainability across applications and environments   

 
 Participate in code reviews and promote engineering best practices   

 
 Maintain technical documentation, deployment procedures, and operational runbooks   

 
 Collaborate closely with development and operations teams, balancing responsibilities across both domains as project needs evolve   

 

 Your Profile:   

 Minimum of   5 + years of professional experience   in Java software development   

 
 Strong   proficiency   in   Java   and object-oriented programming principles   

 
 Experience developing and   maintaining   RESTful APIs and microservices   

 
 Familiarity with   event-driven systems and pub/sub messaging patterns   

 
 Hands-on experience with   CI/CD platforms   such as Bamboo, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or similar   

 
 Experience working with   Docker   and containerized applications   

 
 Knowledge of   Kubernetes   concepts and deployment practices   

 
 Experience working with cloud platforms, preferably   AWS   

 
 Strong understanding of   Git-based version control systems   and development workflows   

 
 Experience with repositories and delivery platforms such as   GitHub, Bitbucket, Bamboo , or similar tools   

 
 Familiarity with application monitoring, logging, observability, and alerting solutions   

 
 Understanding of software engineering best practices, testing strategies, and code quality standards   

 
 Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and communication skills   

 
 Ability and willingness to work across both software development and DevOps responsibilities   

 
   

 Plus  if you have:      

 Experience using AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, etc.)   

 
 Experience implementing observability solutions using Prometheus, Grafana,   OpenTelemetry , Splunk, or Datadog   

 
 Experience working in financial services, capital markets, or electronic trading environments   

 
 Exposure to high-availability and low-latency distributed systems   

 
   

 What’s  in it for you:      

 Competitive compensation package based on experience and skills     

 
 Stable work environment with opportunities for professional growth     

 
 Supportive team and collaborative work culture     

 
 Flexible hours and hybrid work options for a balanced work-life experience     

 
 Private health insurance plan     

 
 Access to continuous training, accredited certifications, unlimited Udemy courses, and other resources to support your professional development     

 
 FitPass  membership promoting well-being and mental health     

 
 Comprehensive Referral Rewards Program    

 

 For any  additional  information or questions, feel free to reach out to us at  Recruitment-Serbia@synechron.com .     

     
 Note:  One prerequisite for this position is that the prospective candidate must  possess  a valid work permit for Serbia.    

     
 We appreciate the interest of all applicants. Please note that only those whose qualifications closely match the position requirements will be contacted for the next steps. All applications will be handled   confidentially .      

   

 S​ YNECHRON’S DIVERSITY & INCLUSION STATEMENT 
 
 Diversity & Inclusion are fundamental to our culture, and Synechron is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) initiative ‘Same Difference’ is committed to fostering an inclusive culture – promoting equality, diversity and an environment that is respectful to all. We strongly believe that a diverse workforce helps build stronger, successful businesses as a global company. We encourage applicants from across diverse backgrounds, race, ethnicities, religion, age, marital status, gender, sexual orientations, or disabilities to apply. We empower our global workforce by offering flexible workplace arrangements, mentoring, internal mobility, learning and development programs, and more. 
 
 All employment decisions at Synechron are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to the applicant’s gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law .
